newsitem.title: UK: Euroclear sees record securities settled in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Euroclear sees record securities settled in 1996.

text.p: The value of securities transactions settled through the Euroclear System increased by 38 percent to a record $34.6 trillion in 1996 versus $25.0 trillion in 1995, Euroclear said in a statement on Wednesday.

"Expanded services covering more domestic markets, high settlement efficiency and value-added client support services helped to generate record volumes of international capital market settlement activity within the Euroclear System," chairman of the board of the Euroclear Clearance System Societe Cooperative Dr Rolf-Ernst Breuer said.

"As the Euroclear System moves towards real-time settlement and prepares for the practical implications of EMU, the record volumes of business directed to the Euroclear System is clear evidence of Euroclear participant trust and confidence in our efforts," Breuer added.
The value of securities held for participants at year-end 1996 reached a record $2.1 trillion, more then 10 percent above the 1995 level of $1.9 trillion, the statement said.
It said the number of new Euroclear participants from emerging markets continued to increase in 1996.
Euroclear said the mark was the most frequently selected Euroclear settlement currency commanding 49.7 percent of total Euroclear turnover in 1996.
